|---------|--------|----------|

```yaml
for: 2m
expr: avg_over_time(p95_latency[5m]) > 89.0
```

```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "Service": "s3.amazonaws.com" },
  "Action": "s3:PutObject",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::backup-bucket/*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {
      "s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "AES256"
    }
  }
}
```
→ Confirmed via AWS CLI: `aws s3api head-object --bucket backup-bucket --key velero/...` returns `ServerSideEncryption: AES256`. |
